title: Wiki CLI show, lint, and check commands
description:
Researcher second-pass on research-pod wiki (11 concepts, 51 sources). Wiki CLI is still render-only on their install.

**Gap:** `kbs wiki show`, `lint`, and `check` are unrecognized. Search is already tracked in kbs-3d8ff3.

**Need:**
- `kbs wiki show <page>` — print page source or a useful page view without a full render pipeline
- `kbs wiki lint` and/or `kbs wiki check` — validate the wiki tree, especially internal `.md` links

**Delivered in:** PR #172 (cursor/wiki-research-kb-d8c6)
